```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

pbc <- readRDS("data/activities/mod01_pbc.rds")

pbc$sex <- factor(pbc$sex,
    levels = c(1, 2),
    labels = c("Male", "Female"))

pbc$sex <- factor(pbc$stage,
    levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4))
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

ggplot(data=pbc, mapping = aes(x=stage)) +
  geom_bar() +
  xlab("Stage of disease") +
  ylab("Frequency")
```
